pinned_reachable.why: control: the pinned rule is safe while every attempt can reach the provider

pinned_outage.why: CP-F4: a lost response, then an outage, then the deadline; confirmed on the runtime by contract probe CP-F4

pinned_skew_reachable.why: clock skew alone does not break it; CP-F1 also needs the later attempt to be unable to reach the provider

confirmfinal_all.why: making a confirmation final does not help when the operation closes before the earlier attempt reports

sticky_all.why: uncertainty sticky alone holds under outage, crash and skew

sticky_confirmfinal_all.why: both rules together hold under outage, crash and skew
